card.name: Active/inactive after its or the
card.fires_on: The words active, inactive or activity right after "its", "the" or "any of the" in drug label text, usually before metabolite or ingredients.

modes.label: its active metabolite
modes.description: The word active after a drug name and "its", leading into metabolite.
modes.example: Saxagliptin and its<< active>> metabolite are removed by hemodialysis

modes.label: inactive ingredients
modes.description: The word inactive after "any of the" in hypersensitivity statements.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to hydrocodone, homatropine, or any of the<< inactive>> ingredients in Hydrocodone Bitartr

modes.label: enhance the activity
modes.description: The word activity after "enhance the" in interaction text.
modes.example: Tricyclic Antidepressants Clinical Impact: May enhance the<< activity>> of tricyclic or sympathom
